summary: Metric the custom objective acts on. Required within custom.
range: Required enum: for type=min -> vehicles | completion_time; for type=min-max -> tasks | travel_cost.
constraints: Must be valid for the chosen type.
businessRules: value defines: The value parameter accepts four inputs, two of them are valid for min type and other two are valid for min-max type custom objective. Let’s look at the values for min type objective: * vehicles: S…
Valid options: vehicles, completion_time, travel_cost, tasks. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: options.objective.custom.type. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
validationRules: value not valid for the chosen type -> 400.
testingGuidance: Positive: type=min, value=completion_time (finish everything as early as possible).
Positive: test with value set to "vehicles"
Positive: test with value set to "completion_time"
Positive: test with value set to "travel_cost"
Positive: test with value set to "tasks"
